review.en: One hundred Chan cases chosen with verses by Xuedou Chongxian, to which Yuanwu Keqin added introductions and running commentary in his lectures. Dense, playful and allusive, it became a core text of koan practice. Yuanwu's student Dahui is said to have burned the blocks for fear it would be studied instead of lived; it was later reprinted and still is in Rinzai Zen.
review.zh: 雪窦重显选出一百则公案并作颂，圜悟克勤在讲说中为之加上垂示、着语和评唱，便成此书。文字繁密、机锋活泼、典故丛生，成为参公案的核心典籍。相传圜悟的弟子大慧宗杲怕学人只钻文字，曾焚毁书版；后来重新刊行，日本临济宗至今使用。
